race.description: Twin City Truck Centre Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ROSCOMAIN BILL (1) is the most appealing of the first starters, with a second in his latest Wodonga jumpout and the Donna Scott/Blaike McDougall combination bringing strong local credentials. Lobs in a suitable race on debut and can make a winning start to his career. LULL US AWAY (8) has the best recent exposed run, beaten a nose at this track after just failing to hold on, and her consistency keeps her right in the argument despite another 1400m query. TASSY FOX (11) is better than the plain fifth last start suggests after being bumped and racing wide, while her two placings from four starts at this venue give her a base to rebound from. COOL IDOL (3) is another Donna Scott newcomer with three trials behind her and enough family form around 1200m to 1400m. Ticks a few boxes and won't be far away. SMOKIN'ANNIVERSARY (4) can resume on a positive note.
